metadata.topic: Ratios and rates in a word problem

annotator.notes: The tutor strictly adheres to the never_state policy by refusing to provide or confirm the final answer, even when the student presents their calculation, due to the live quiz scenario.

task_context.problem_statement:
23 children were riding on the bus. At the bus stop 24 children got on the bus while some got off the bus. Then there were 8 children altogether on the bus.
How many more children got off the bus than those that got on?
( 23.0 - 8.0 )
